intent: make local root render the realtime DX page directly instead of relying on meta refresh

lines: html, body { margin: 0; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; background: #050607; }
iframe { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; border: 0; background: #050607; }
.fallback { position: fixed; inset: auto 16px 16px 16px; color: #9ca79f; font: 13px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }
If the frame does not load, open dx.html.
Local root note: `site/index.html` embeds `dx.html` directly so the in-app browser does not depend on meta-refresh behavior.
